messages:
Priya: Desert-island snack question: you get ONE snack for the rest of your life. What is it? no substitutions.
Dan: Salted caramel popcorn. crunchy + sweet = eternal happiness. :popcorn:
Jess: Dried mango. lightweight, tangy, and sunshine-y.
Omar: Beef jerky. protein + chew. not romantic but practical.
Nia: Chocolate-covered almonds. fight me. :chocolate_bar::almond:
peanut_bot: Friendly reminder: if you pick something with peanuts, mark it as allergen-safe for others. :warning:
Theo: Instant ramen packets? counts as snack? noodle starch life. :ramen:
Priya: Good variety. Vote by emoji: :popcorn: = popcorn, :mango: = dried mango (use :sun_with_face: if no mango emoji), :meat_on_bone: = jerky, :chocolate_bar: = choc/almond, :ramen: = ramen, :question: = other
Dan: :popcorn:
Jess: :sun_with_face:
Omar: :meat_on_bone:
Nia: :chocolate_bar: (also secretly a fruit person)
Theo: :ramen:
Priya: Tally: popcorn 1, mango 1, jerky 1, chocolate 1, ramen 1. Tie chaos. Any wild takes?
Jess: My true answer would be a never-empty jar of peanut butter but I won’t pick it publicly.
Omar: I actually rotate between 3 snacks mentally, cheating via imagination.
Nia: If we get stranded, well send a rescue signal made of chocolate wrappers.
Priya: Thanks yall. This will not help in an actual emergency but made my commute fun. :white_check_mark:
